# The Sea


It lies there, supple and unchanging. Around me, white birds and rusted houses. In the breaking of the waves, there is something of your voice. In the foam, a glint of your smile.

The sea rocks my soul the way it did that evening, when a song by Charles Trenet brought us closer, a little more with each chorus. Now, every wave carries me back to that moment.
